system.description:
Lyo draws his blade just as quickly as his enemies drew theirs. Standing in the middle of the road, he realizes he has been surrounded by about a dozen adversaries. They assault him from the shadows throwing kunai and shuriken at him with relentless efficiency. He with his sword drawn begins to parry them all with ruthless focus. Each swing of his cuts, breaks, or deflects three or more weapons launched at him. He keeps up this defense before he realizes he can’t keep it up much longer. He takes a deep breath, as the weapons begin to strike his body, bouncing off of his skin as he dashes into the darkness. The singing of blades cutting through the air ring out as the fighting slowly quiets down to nothing more than a whisper. Lyo comes staggering out of the brush with his hand up in victory, showing his client that he is a lot tougher than he looks.

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 4 excerpt.

The Basilisk’s Blessings

Tag: Homebrew, Creator: Kingsare4ever, Soren

The Hebi Clan also known as the Serpent Clan, or the Viper Clan were once slaves to a conniving master in the Land of Serpents. After escaping the shackles of oppression, they would become pivotal in their lands history, until being expelled, after the 3 Clan War, migrating south through the rest of the Shinobi world, finding themselves settled in the land of Fangs.

The Hebi has the kekkei genkai called Vipers Blood. This Bloodline allows all Hebi clansmen to produce a uniquely poison compound with themselves. This poison enables a Hebi to regenerate from harm, or severely envenom a foe. The Hebi are feared swordsmen, infiltration experts and alchemists within their new home, brining with them their religious faith of the Basilisk’s blessings.

Hebi Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str or Dex, +1 Con

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Survival, Animal Handling

Weapon Proficiencies: You are proficient with Katana’s, Broadswords and Odachi. Tool Proficiencies: Poisoner’s Kit.

Hebi Clan Jutsu: The Hebi have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list.

Hijutsu Flexibility: Hebi Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Constitution as its casting ability score.

Snake Speech: Hebi Clansmen are known for their affinity with snakes. You can communicate with and understand snakes and reptiles.

Snake Mimicry: Your heritage and history with your clans snakes has granted you enhanced senses. You have 10 feet of Tremor sense.

Hebi Features

Serpents Blood

1st Level Clan Feature

The Land of Fangs most noble family of shinobi. Born to a lineage of slaves, the Hebi vowed to never fall back into being any one persons servant, except for themselves. To ensure this, they would take and breed their own special lineage of highly venomous snakes, and harvest its venom, to ingest, drink and consume to build their bodies ability to produce it themselves.

As a child of this lineage, you carry a pool venom, called Viper Blood within your body, equal to 1 + proficiency bonus. You can spend this venom on features that call for it, regaining all spent Viper Blood when you complete a rest of any type.

Alternatively, your Viper Blood can be replenished once per turn, as a Bonus Action, by consuming a charge of a Poisoners Kit¸ or once per turn, when you deal melee damage to a creature with ranks of Envenomed you regain 1 Viper Blood.

Additionally, while you have Viper Blood, your body is constantly in a state of cellular regeneration, attempting to close wounds and heal sickness. While in combat, at the beginning of each of your turns, if you have 1 or more Viper Blood, you regain hit points equal to half your level. If you ever have 3 or more combined ranks of Physical or Elemental conditions, this regeneration is disabled until you are below this threshold. If you regain hit points from this effect, while at 0 hit points, you gain 1 failed death saving throw.

Serpent’s Coil

Good Luck. / A Virulent creature cannot regain hit or chakra points. / A Virulent creature cannot gain temporary hit points or chakra points. / A Virulent creature reduces its damage die size by 1 step. If they use a d4, it instead becomes 1 damage, per dice that would be rolled. / Creatures that are resistant or immune to poison damage or the Envenomed condition are resistant or immune to the Virulent condition. / A creature can spend its action to make a DC 15 Constitution check to remove this condition. |

1st Level Clan Feature

The Hebi are prolific in their ability with a blade. Master swordsmen, their style of fighting is akin to an aggressive serpent coiling into itself and striking forward with its fangs erect. You learn the Serpent’s Coil Bukijutsu stance. This stance can only be used with weapons from the Blade Weapon Group.

As part of entering this stance and at the beginning of each of your turns while in this stance, you can spend 1 Vipers Blood to infuse your weapon with concentrated venom for the next minute. While your weapon is infused and you are in this stance, [Weapon Damage] you deal becomes poison, and it gains a rank of Mastery to their damage rolls. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.

In place of an attack made as part of your Attack Action, you can instead make a Viper Strike or a Python Strike. Alternatively, by spending 1 Viper Blood, you can use a Strike ability as part of a Hebi Clan Hijutsu you cast., applying their saving throw on a successful hit or failed saving throw.

Hebi Clan Hijutsu, gain their Serpent Coil effects.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Viper Strike. Once per turn, make a weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage], ignoring temporary hit points a creature may have. By spending 2 Viper Blood as part of this attack, you force them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they become Virulent until the beginning of your next turn. If an affected creature has ranks of Envenomed, you can choose to reduce those ranks to 0, and inflict Virulent, for the next minute. Your [Weapon Damage] dealt as part of this Viper Strike increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Python Strike. Once per turn, make a weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] If the target is currently Grappled, Restrained, or has their movement speed reduced by an effect you or an allied creature applied, this attack gains a +1 bonus to its critical threat range. On a critical hit, by spending 1 Viper Blood, this attack gains the Deadly 2 property. This increases to Deadly 3 at 7th level and Deadly 4 at 15th level.

Venomous Technique

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Hebi Clan has spent generations cultivating their clans special breed of serpent and using its hyper potent venom to further enhance their clans station. The Hebi have developed a special organ that stores their Viper Blood. This organ with training, can be manipulated to express a series of techniques only possible for the Hebi called Venom Arts. The first of which all Hebi has is their ability to metabolize it to suppress extreme conditions they may experience.

If you end your turn with ranks of a Physical or Elemental condition, you can spend 1 Viper Blood, to make a Constitution saving throw vs a DC 15 + 1 for each Physical or Elemental condition rank you have. On a success, you remove 1 rank of an aforementioned condition.

You know one Venom Art of your choice, gaining an additional Venom Art at 7th and 15th levels. Effects that force a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC. If a Venom Art inflicts Virulent, it lasts until the beginning of your next turn unless otherwise stated. If an affected creature has ranks of Envenomed, you can choose to reduce those ranks to 0, and inflict Virulent, for the next minute.

Venomous Refresh

Once per turn, as a Bonus action on your turn, you can spend 2 Viper Blood forcing it to cycle through your mind, washing over your brain and nervous system. When you do, select one Mental or Sensory condition you currently have, reducing its ranks by 2, except for the Sealed condition.

Venomous Regeneration

Once per turn, as a Bonus action on your turn, you can spend multiples of 2 Viper Blood, up to a max of 10. When you do, you roll 1 Hit die for every 2 Viper Blood spent. This does not spend your rolled hit die. You regain hit points equal to the result.

Venomous Augmentation

As a Bonus action, you can spend 2 Viper Blood, to circulate it throughout your muscles, having it act as a potent stimulant. Until the end of your next turn;

Your speed is increased by +10. This is increased by +10 at 7th and 15th levels.

Strength and Dexterity Checks you make gain a rank of Mastery. This increases to two ranks at 7th and 15th level.

Suppress the effects of Physical conditions you have for the duration.

Coiling – Black Mamba

Your Vipers Blood coils around your weapon just as you strike with it, manifesting the afterimage of a black mambas black maw striking with deadly precision. While in your Serpents Coil stance, once per turn, as a Reaction to taking damage from a hostile creature within your weapons range, you can make a Mamba Strike.

Mamba Strike. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, roll your [Weapon Damage], recording the result. First, reduce the triggering damage you would take by the result. Then, the triggering creature takes the recorded [Weapon Damage] and forces them to make a Strength saving throw, being pushed 20 feet away from the Hebi on a failure. By spending 1 Viper Blood, if the triggering creature fails this saving throw, you can move up to half your speed. If you end this movement within weapon range of the them, you can make one additional weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] on a hit and inflicting them with Virulent. Your [Weapon Damage] dealt as part of this Mamba Strike increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Coiling – Silver Cobra

Your Vipers Blood coils around your weapon just as you strike with it, manifesting the afterimage of a Silver Cobras opened hood coiling around your weapon, striking in unison. While in your Serpents Coil stance, once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action or opportunity attack, you can instead make a Cobra Strike.

Cobra Strike. Make a Weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] on a hit. Then, you can move 10 feet, spending your remaining movement. If this movement puts you within range of a different hostile creature, you can repeat this attack against them. You can repeat this movement and attack string, always targeting a creature you haven’t previously attacked as part of this Cobra strike, until you run out of movement speed. Your [Weapon Damage] dealt as part of each Cobra Strike increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Coiling – Emerald Basilisk

Your Vipers Blood coils around your weapon just as you strike with it, manifesting the afterimage of an Emerald Basilisk coiling around you and your opponent like Jormungand the world serpent. While in your Serpents Coil stance, once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action or opportunity attack, you can instead make a Basilisk Strike.

Basilisk Strike. Make a Weapon attack comparing the result vs the AC of all creatures of your choice within your weapons range, in a radius around you. If the target creature(s) has ranks of Envenomed or Virulent, treat their AC as -2 lower to determine if you score a hit. On a hit, you deal your [Weapon Damage] to target creatures on a hit. Your [Weapon Damage] dealt as part of this Basilisk Strike increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Serpents Cloud

As an Action, by spending 2 Viper Blood, you can exhale cloud of aerosolized venom, into either a 20-foot radius, centered on you, or a 30-foot cone originating from you. All creatures in range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure they take 3d6 poison damage and become Virulent, or half as much damage on a success. Increase damage by +2d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Beginning at 11th level, creatures with ranks of Bleed suffer a -1 penalty to their saving throw for every rank they have.

Serpents Bite

As a Bonus action, by spending 1 Viper Blood, you elongate your fangs like that of a snakes and gain the Serpents Bite, until the beginning of your next turn.

In place of an attack made as part of the Attack Action, Opportunity attack or a Hijutsu you cast; you can make a Serpent Bite allowing you to use your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility.

Serpent Bite. Make an unarmed attack, dealing 3d6+your modifier in Poison damage on a hit, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, gaining a rank of Envenomed on a failure. Increase the damage of this Bite by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels. Also increase the ranks of Envenomed by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.

Virulent Blood

Once per turn, when you begin your turn with at least one rank of Envenomed, you can reduce one of the aforementioned conditions ranks by 1. When you do, you regain 2 Viper Blood as your body converts it into fuel for you.

Beginning at 11th level, if you have ranks of Envenomed you ignore its effect preventing you from regaining hit points and its ranks do not count against your hit point regeneration from the Serpent Blood clan feature. Instead, increase the amount of hit points you regain from your Viper Blood clan feature, by +2, for every rank of Envenomed you have.

Virulent Infusion

As part of casting a Ninjutsu, or a Bukijutsu using a weapon from the Blade Group, you can spend 1 Viper Blood. If you do, on a failed save, in place of one condition the jutsu inflicts, you can inflict the Virulent condition following the jutsu’s normal rules. If the jutsu does not inflict a condition, then force one affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw vs jutsu’s save DC, becoming Virulent on a failure.

If you spend 3 Viper Blood as part of the aforementioned jutsu disciplines casting, then you can inflict both Virulent condition and the jutsu’s original condition. Also, if the jutsu does not inflict a condition, then you can force all affected creatures to make the Constitution saving throw, gaining the Virulent condition, on a failure.

Serpents Guile

At the beginning of each of your turns, you regain 1 Viper Blood and Hebi Clan features and effects that cost 2 or more Viper Blood, cost one less. / Basilisk’s Health. When you regain hit points as a result of the Serpent Blood clan feature, you instead regain hit points equal to your level and When you spend Viper Blood to attempt to remove ranks of a Physical or Elemental conditions through the Venomous Technique clan feature, you make that saving throw at advantage. / Basilisk’s Coil. Once per turn, it costs 0 Viper Blood to use a Strike ability as part of a Hebi Clan Hijutsu you cast. |

7th Level Clan Feature

The Hebi Clan are known for their intelligence networks throughout the shinobi world, having released specially trained snakes of different breeds across the land. Their ability to communicate with them, allows them to collect information from these snakes, without ever having to interact with another human once.

By spending 10 minutes performing a sleeper serpent ritual, you release a guiding pulse, calling on snakes within a 1-mile radius to you. These snakes share with you one piece of information or rumors or hint about the area, that the snakes collected during their time here. If the terrain or area is void of snakes, none heed your call. Once you call upon serpents in this way, they cannot be called upon again, until you complete a long rest.

Alternatively, you can spend 10 minutes performing the Viper Form ritual, spending 2 Viper Blood, to perform a special transformation, temporarily shapeshifting your biology, into that of a Tiny or Small sized snake for up to 1 hour or dismissed. While transformed in this way, you’re clothing and carrying containers melds onto you with a similar, but smaller design as what you had in your humanoid state, but for a snake, and you drop all weapons and things not sealed inside of scrolls. you gain a 60-foot swim speed, can move across walls and ceilings freely, gain 10 feet of Blind Sight, and cannot be identified by creatures as being anything other than a snake. You cannot cast Jutsu or make weapon attacks. Taking damage, immediately dispels this form, unless you spend 1 Viper Blood to resist and sustain the form. Once you transform in this way you cannot do so again, until you complete a long rest.

Blood of the Basilisk

11th Level Clan Feature

The blood of chain breakers, survivors and those who value their freedom, over subjugation still run through your veins. You have reached the level of strength to be blessed by the Basilisk. You wish to become the embodiment of the Basilisk himself. You can embody this blessing, as scales push through painting your body, arms and necks. Your pupils narrow to vertical slits, and your hands and even weapons bleed your Viper Blood. This augmented battle state, is known as your Basilisk’s Blessing.

As a Bonus action, by spending 4 Viper Blood, to activate your Basilisk’s Blessing for the next minute, until you are incapacitated, or your dismiss it on your turn, at no action. Once you activate this state, you cannot enter it again, until you complete a short rest.

Ouroboros

15th Level Clan Feature

You have become the serpent that feeds on itself, to become perfection. One that completes itself, by itself. The Ouroboros. The Breaker of chains, and the infinite serpent.

When you roll initiative, your Viper Blood surges within you, breaking the very chains of fate that bind you, as you can feel the gaze of the Basilisk upon you, granting you strength. You can use any combination of two of the following abilities, once per long rest.

Venom of Inevitability. When a creature with the Virulent feature makes a roll with a D20, you can dispel their condition, to treat their roll result as a 1.

Chain Breaker. When you would begin your turn with Physical, Mental, Elemental or Sensory conditions, you can spend 1 Viper Blood, per condition, reducing its ranks to 0, except for the Grappled condition.

The Infinite Circle. When you fall to 0 hit points, you can spend your reaction to force your body to refuel, granting you double, your current maximum Viper Blood until the end of initiative, and you regain hit points equal to twice your level.

Gaze of the Basilisk. When you enter your Basilisk’s Blessing state, until the end of your next turn, the first time each turn a creature targets you with an attack or jutsu, they gain 2 rank of Shaken and Demoralized but only against you or affects you would apply to them. These ranks of Shaken and Demoralized are dispelled at the end of your following turn.

Basilisks Venom. When you inflict a creature with Virulent, if you spend 2 Viper Blood, then at end of that creatures turn, they must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, the affected creature is Petrified for the next 48 Hours (2 Days). If this petrified creature would take damage, or suffer a hostile effect, the Petrification ends immediately.
